leviFromDESeq2

Source: R/leviFromDE.R
leviFromDESeq2.Rd

Convert a DESeq2 result object into a data.frame compatible with levi's expressionInput parameter.

leviFromDESeq2(dds_result, gene_col = "GeneID")

Arguments

dds_result

A DESeqResults object returned by DESeq2::results(), or any data.frame with columns baseMean and log2FoldChange.

gene_col

Character. Name for the gene identifier column. Default is "GeneID".

Value

A data.frame with columns: gene identifier, baseMean (abundance annotation) and log2FoldChange, ready to pass to levi(expressionInput = ...).

Details

Use signal_mode = "logfc" and readExpColumn("log2FoldChange-log2FoldChange"). The baseMean column is annotation, not a control measurement. Rows with NA in log2FoldChange are removed automatically.

Examples

mock_res <- data.frame(
    baseMean       = c(120, 45, 80),
    log2FoldChange = c(2.1, -1.4, 0.2),
    row.names      = c("GENE1", "GENE2", "GENE3")
)
expr_df <- leviFromDESeq2(mock_res)
head(expr_df)
#>   GeneID baseMean log2FoldChange
#> 1  GENE1      120            2.1
#> 2  GENE2       45           -1.4
#> 3  GENE3       80            0.2
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(DESeq2)
res <- results(dds)
expr_df <- leviFromDESeq2(res, gene_col = "GeneSymbol")
} # }
